name: cRZStd::vf1 (Assert: debug level from the framework or GZFRAMEWORK_DEBUG_LEVEL, logged as ASSERT, reported to StdOut / StdErr or the debugger, asked in a message box; catch(...); ret 4)
notes: Lane LZ (F4c). Hooked (src/hook/tables/cRZStd.cpp). Fakes for the framework (global 0x10c9378), the log service and its system face, the message server, the streams, the lock at 0x10cb5cc and every import; the image's fopen / fwrite / fclose, _snprintf, _vsnprintf_l and atoi stood in by the CRT's; RZSTD_OUTPUT_FILE_PATH a real file per side. ORIGINAL-BUG kept: above level 2 the box is asked when the text pointer's top byte is set, and the report byte is unset stack (ours: the report bit); the test lets the log service take those lines, which clears it on both sides. Test RZStd_Assert (about 3350 cases): random flags, files, texts (none, empty, up to 120), framework or not, levels from the framework, the environment (valid, 2, empty, too long, not a number) or the global, log service / system face / running, streams that take the text or not or throw (the catch path), box answers 1-5, window checks; compared the result, the flags after, the call log (with every text), the debug level global, the output file and the frees. Coverage floors: 200 asked, 400 shown, 20 thrown, 100 to the file. Mutants killed here: the file flag ignored, the no-ask level asking, the top-byte ask, ignore clearing only the ask bit, the answer not stored, the catch's DebugText dropped, the stream not released, StdOut / StdErr swapped, the begin / end messages swapped, the lock not released. 25 mutants (lane LZ): 22 killed. Equivalent: the report-to-StdOut condition without the report bit (shown only when report is set); accepting a GetEnvironmentVariableA result of 16 for the 16-byte level text (the API returns at most 15 when the value fits and 17 or more when not).
